name: Migración Colombia
body: A 301 from http to https, a canonical on the home page, and GA4. But /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return 404, so crawlers get no map of the site and no rules to follow.
lesson: Publish robots.txt with a Sitemap: line, and generate the sitemap from your CMS so it stays current.
summary: www.migracioncolombia.gov.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 10 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-10-29, issued by Sectigo Limited.
fix.fix: Renew now and check that automatic renewal works.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /atencion-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion/pqrs-aranda-1/preguntas-frecuentes, /atencion-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion/pqrs-aranda-1/glorario. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia, /tramites-y-servicios/todos, /atencion-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 352 ms
Language alternates point at each other
